notes.content:
[list]
[*]We have improved and optimized all menu interfaces.

[/list]

[b]Have fun in Discreet![/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]ːsteamhappyː FULL OF SKINS ! ːsteamhappyː[/h1]

With the update 1.2.0 you can now buy skins in the store with "In-Game" money that you will earn as you play.

[h3] The skins available in version 1.2.0 are :[/h3]
[list]
[*] HoloGirl
[*] CyberMonk
[*] Android
[*] PoliceGirl
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h3]ːsteamhappyːUPDATE 1.0.4ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

A new map is appearing on Discreet!

[Night Town]

[list]
[*] You are a thief and you want to earn a lot of money, the best way is to go and steal the houses of Night Town. With a maximum loot of 25,000$ you will then be ready to take a great vacation.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Be careful if you own a house in Night Town! Protect your valuable furniture so you don't end up on the street.
[/list]
